summary: Publishes 17 created-card proxies and wires 18 creators (inventory 1986 wired). Mendon 2026-10-06: Ivory-frame Oracle proxies are acceptable where no other frame exists, and Oracle exact matches are preferred over manufactured scans. Sixteen proxies are Ivory Edition or Emperor-era Oracle masters; Hiruma Koru uses Oracle's Disposable Troops (Celestial frame), not the supplied Koru's Retinue; Abdollah uses Oracle's Zombie. Creators wired: Abdollah, Ashalan Ambush, Goju Kaxt, Hiruma Koru, Kuni Renyu exp2, New Cavalry Tactics, Yojimbo of Earth, Kitsune Yamazaru, Kitsune Kichi exp, Komori Miyano, The Onyx Dueling Circle, The Wind's Champion, Never Without a Weapon, Shard of the Great Death's Bones, A New Perspective, Daigotsu Hashibei, Shinjo Tselu exp2, Recruitment Effort. Shared edits are one-line calls in MatchEngine.ApplyMandatoryEntryEffects, EmperorRulingR4 TraitReactions.Is, ActionEffectTracking.AfterActionResolvedApplies and EmperorThreeS.AfterCardDestroyed (plus whitespace the format check required there).
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: exit 0, 3014 of 3014 tests, bot soak stall=0. check_format and lint_comment_swallow clean. Art pack catalogue-art-issue677-20261006-r1 (4433 images, 35 new) verified with ensure_catalogue_art --archive and --verify-only. No Godot or native client run.
remaining: 24 readings for Mendon in docs/decisions/2026-10-06-677-created-card-proxies.md; whether the Ivory-frame ruling becomes a RULINGS.md entry. Unwired with notes: Constructing the Self, The Tower of Vigilance, Kitsune Yuribara, Isawa Tsumaro, Daigotsu Kikumura (their proxies are published). The new proxy receipts have no working_copy block, so a fresh clone must re-download those masters before rerunning the packager. No .import sidecars for the 35 new scans.
